inputs.text: Image 1 is a frame from a video. The young man in an orange hoodie and red cap becomes the pumpkin-headed scarecrow shown in image 2 and image 3, with that one's own face, head, hair, skin, hands and build: A tall pumpkin-headed scarecrow with a carved jack-o'-lantern head, a frayed straw hat, a patched brown flannel shirt, burlap gloves with straw poking out of the cuffs, and worn denim overalls, dressed head to toe in the outfit from those pictures (top, trousers or skirt, legs and shoes). Nothing of the original person's face, hair, hands, wig, headwear or clothes stays, not a skirt, legging or shoe. It takes exactly the pose, size and place of the one it replaces: the same turn of the body and head, the same arms, hands and legs, holding and touching what they touched. Its hands stay in plain view wherever the original's are, never hidden by sleeves, cuffs, straw or fur. Their exact position, kept as it is: The young man stands with his body and head facing right, arms hanging straight down at his sides, legs straight with feet together on the ground. Keep everything else in image 1 exactly as it is: the place, the light, the other people and things, the framing and any text over the picture.
